items.alt: A Korean 원고지 manuscript grid filled with hand-drawn scenes from Ryan Choi's life, from a toddler swinging a golf club to a desk overlooking San Francisco.

content.text: Korea born, England raised, San Francisco based. Philosophy, Politics and Economics major at Warwick, spent two years carrying a machine gun for the Korean Missile Command, and spent a decade exploring how companies get built, bought, and sold — Tech M&A at SVB and Moelis, then CoS at Artie.

I'm interested in arts, technology, philosophy, and the strange business of figuring out what makes a life meaningful. I'm particularly drawn to philosophy through film — the kind of movies that leave you baffled, then send you down an endless maze of questions.
Manchester United fan since 2007. Golfer since age 2, though the evidence remains inconclusive.
